table_title: Discharge, in cubic feet per second, water year October 1953 to September 1954
location_text: Lat 35°34', long. 120°48', in Paso de Robles Grant, on left bank 1.4 miles upstream from mouth, 1.8 miles northwest of Oakdale school, and 5.6 miles west of Templeton, San Luis Obispo County.
quantities_units: discharge (cubic feet per second); monthly total (cfs-days), mean (cfs) and runoff (acre-feet) in summary rows
notes: No station number is printed. October to December 1953 and August to September 1954 are blank with no flow (totals 0); printed daily values run January to July 1954. Coordinates are printed to the minute only.
